31 weeks + 7 days = 31 × 7 + 7 = 217 + 7 = 224 days.  
1817 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 04-28-1817, add 224 days:  
April: 2 days left (29, 30) → 2 days used, 222 left.  
May: 31 → 222-31=191  
June: 30 → 191-30=161  
July: 31 → 161-31=130  
August: 31 → 130-31=99  
September: 30 → 99-30=69  
October: 31 → 69-31=38  
November: 30 → 38-30=8  
December: add 8 days → 1817-12-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1817-12-08
